literal: Even those who lack strength, having gathered strength, will conquer, the right place having known, against enemies, guarding themselves, if they act.
translation: Even those who lack strength will gather strength and conquer their enemies, if they choose the right place, guard themselves well, and then act.
modern: வலிமை இல்லாதவர்களும் கூட, தகுந்த இடத்தை அறிந்து, தங்களைப் பாதுகாத்துக் கொண்டு, பகைவர்களுக்கு எதிராகச் செயல்பட்டால், வலிமை பெற்று வெற்றி பெறுவார்கள்.
explanation: This couplet emphasizes the power of choosing the right location in overcoming a stronger adversary. Even those who are naturally weak can defeat their enemies if they act with careful self-protection. The key lies in knowing the right place and preparing themselves adequately. By choosing a strategic location that favors them and disadvantages the enemy, the weak can neutralize the enemy's strength and emerge victorious.
